meta.name: create-image-gpt-image-fal
meta.description: Generate a single photoreal or designed image with OpenAI gpt-image via fal.ai. Supports gpt-image-1 (default, fixed sizes — the FAL fallback for Higgsfield's `gpt_image_2`) and gpt-image-2 (`openai/gpt-image-2`, custom output sizes up to 3840px). Routes to text-to-image or the edit variant depending on whether a reference image is provided. Use for photoreal character anchors, scene keyframes, and designed sheets (e.g. storyboards) where precise layout and legible text matter.

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成逼真或设计感图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成高质量概念图或设计稿。
